Application Composition and Transports
|-- Server composition: createBackend() [src/server/app/bootstrap.ts]
|   |-- Chooses concrete integrations and injects them into application services
|   |   |-- NEW_DIAGRAM_AGENT == "fake"
|   |   |   |-- Fake runtimes: local chat, mapping, diagram edits, compaction, evals, comparison
|   |   |   `-- Otherwise: CodexLocalChat, PiMapping, PiDiagramEdit, PiFileCompaction,
|   |   |       AgentContextEval and CodexComparison runtimes
|   |   |-- piEnabled === true -> passed to real AI integrations and workflow enablement
|   |   |   `-- AgentChat still uses StdioCodexConnection; diff workflows use PiDiffSessionRuntime
|   |   `-- lspEnabled === true -> ProjectLanguageService; otherwise undefined
|   |-- Persistence and core application [shared store]
|   |   |-- DiagramStore(projectRoot, diagramsDirectory)
|   |   |   `-- storeRoot -> filesystem stores for contexts, workspace, changes, chat and evals
|   |   |-- corpusAccess = provider + readDocumentLines + discover
|   |   |-- CoreApplication <- store + corpusAccess
|   |   |-- ProjectSourceService <- store + corpusAccess + optional language service
|   |   |-- ProjectCatalogService <- store
|   |   `-- MappingDiagramService <- store + corpusAccess + project/profile + WorkspaceRecordStore
|   |-- Agent and live-canvas access
|   |   |-- FileAgentContextSources
|   |   |   |-- sourceId starts with repo- -> resolve repository checkout as git-worktree
|   |   |   `-- Other source -> require initialized project -> resolve diagram source corpus
|   |   |-- AgentContextLibrary <- FileAgentContextRepository + context sources
|   |   |   `-- AgentContextService <- library
|   |   |-- FileDiagramAgentContextStore <- storeRoot + context sources
|   |   |-- GenerationCanvasBridge wraps CanvasSessionBridge [shared bridge]
|   |   |-- LiveCanvasService <- bridge.list + bridge.dispatch(context)
|   |   |   `-- Also receives AgentContextService + CanvasApiProjection [shared projection]
|   |   |-- ChangeSessionService <- DiagramChangeSessionStore + store + bridge
|   |   `-- AgentDiagrammingSessionService <- bridge + diagrams + store + QuickJsAgentRuntime
|   |       `-- Also receives changes, edit runtime, contexts, projection and diagram context store
|   |-- Two chat services
|   |   |-- LocalChatService <- store + corpusAccess + selected chat runtime + source root
|   |   `-- AgentChatService <- StdioCodexConnection + FileChatStore + source root
|   |       |-- LiveCanvasService + shared bridge + context library
|   |       `-- ChatDiagramTools(agent) + MappingChatMcpBinding(agent, process.cwd())
|   |-- Change workflows and push integration
|   |   |-- DiffSessionWorkflowService <- changes + agent + PiDiffSessionRuntime
|   |   |   `-- FileDiffSessionRunStore + prompts + repository-backed source reader
|   |   `-- PushIntegrationService <- FilePushIntegrationStore + GitPushSource + diff workflows
|   |-- Workspace, generation, comparison and evaluation
|   |   |-- MappingWorkspaceService <- store + MappingWorkspaceStore + diagram context store
|   |   |-- GeneratedCanvasCatalog <- store [shared catalog]
|   |   |-- CompareSessionService <- workspace + FileCompareSessionStore + catalog + store
|   |   |-- EvalReferenceService + EvalPromptService
|   |   |   `-- JSON directory stores for references, groups, prompts and project snapshots
|   |   |-- EvalRunService <- compare sessions + workspace + store + context library
|   |   |   |-- Also receives prompts, catalog, eval-run store, selected runtime and rollup store
|   |   |   |-- layoutTemplates <- LayoutTemplateService + JSON store + compare sessions + store
|   |   |   |-- histories <- FileCanvasTimeline
|   |   |   |-- referenceGenerations <- ReferenceGenerationService + AgentChat + eval runs
|   |   |   |-- AgentChat generation observer -> evalRuns.recordLegacy()
|   |   |   |-- Legacy replay/cancel -> AgentChat; change-session reads -> changes.get()
|   |   |   `-- catalog.snapshot -> evalRuns.outputSnapshot()
|   |   |-- ComparisonGenerationService <- compare sessions + FileComparisonRunStore + runtime
|   |   `-- EvalRunService extensions
|   |       |-- JudgementService <- JSON store + compare sessions + comparison store/service + eval store
|   |       |-- ExperimentService <- JSON store + eval runs + store + context library
|   |       `-- deleteContextComparisons -> comparisonRuns.deleteContextOutputs()
|   `-- Exposes routes, liveCanvas, diffSessionWorkflows, pushIntegrations and dispose()
|       |-- createCoreRoutes <- core application + source service + catalog service
|       `-- createMappingRoutes <- composed mapping services
|           |-- SelectionService <- store + mapping runtime + source root
|           |-- FileCompactionService <- core + runtime + FileCompactionStore + prompt/settings loaders
|           `-- Push routes also receive NEW_DIAGRAM_PUSH_TOKEN
|-- Vite transport adapter: diagramApi() [src/server/app/vitePlugin.ts]
|   |-- Calls createBackend() once for this plugin instance
|   |   `-- Defaults: diagramsDirectory=.diagrams; source root=projectRoot;
|   |       domain profile from valid NEW_DIAGRAM_DOMAIN; options={}
|   |-- configureServer and configurePreviewServer -> same attach(server)
|   |   |-- Install HTTP middleware
|   |   `-- If httpServer exists -> attachLiveCanvasSockets(httpServer, backend.liveCanvas)
|   |       `-- Agent-context uploads and canvas writes enabled only when httpEnabled === true
|   |-- HTTP request dispatch
|   |   |-- Outside /api and /internal -> next middleware
|   |   |-- Agent mutation + HTTP disabled + no x-canvas-chat-binding header
|   |   |   `-- 403 HTTP_WRITES_DISABLED
|   |   |-- Not /api/<known namespace> -> 404
|   |   `-- /api/core or /api/mapping -> injected namespace handler
|   |-- Core routes [src/server/routes/core/routes.ts]
|   |   |-- files, source, definitions -> ProjectSourceService
|   |   |   `-- Definitions: ensure enabled; response close aborts unfinished work;
|   |   |       finally remove close listener
|   |   |-- projections, compaction listing -> ProjectCatalogService
|   |   `-- compaction upsert, representations -> CoreApplication
|   |-- Mapping routes [src/server/routes/mapping/routes.ts]
|   |   |-- Optional service present -> delegate matching route family
|   |   |   |-- generated-canvases, evals -> evaluation handlers
|   |   |   |-- comparison-runs, compare-sessions -> comparison handlers
|   |   |   |-- agent-chat, agent -> agent handlers
|   |   |   |-- integrations, workflows/diff-session-create -> push/workflow handlers
|   |   |   `-- live/context/short, live/connections/:id/selection -> live-canvas readers
|   |   |-- workspace, records, export, import-contexts -> MappingWorkspaceService
|   |   |   `-- Workspace write/import/export bodies allow up to 64 MiB
|   |   |-- diagrams save/delete/publish -> MappingDiagramService
|   |   |-- chat -> LocalChatService; compactions -> FileCompactionService
|   |   |-- prompt -> SelectionService.prepare() -> run()
|   |   |   `-- NDJSON stream: progress events -> result event -> end
|   |   `-- Unmatched route -> 404; explicit method checks return 405 on mismatch
|   |-- Transport error translation
|   |   |-- Headers already sent -> error event; end response if still open
|   |   `-- Otherwise -> JSON error
|   |       |-- RequestTooLarge -> 413; ProjectDiagramConflict -> 409
|   |       |-- ApplicationError -> 409 conflict / 400 invalid input / 415 binary source
|   |       |   `-- LSP disabled, AI disabled or storage unavailable -> 503
|   |       `-- Other errors -> 400
|   `-- HTTP server close -> dispose sockets -> backend.dispose()
|       `-- Calls disposal in order
|           |-- comparisonRuns -> evalRuns -> agentChat -> diffSessionWorkflows
|           |-- agent -> diagramEditRuntime -> canvasBridge -> optional languageService
|           `-- mappingRuntime -> chatRuntime -> compactionService
|-- Browser composition [src/app/App.tsx + src/app/services.ts]
|   |-- useState(createMappingServices) -> one service bundle retained by App
|   |   |-- DefaultCanvasHistoryService('current')
|   |   |-- httpDiagramGenerator
|   |   |-- createHttpCodeRepoService()
|   |   `-- WorkspaceStorage
|   |-- Path matches BASE_URL + evals after trailing-slash normalization
|   |   `-- Lazy EvalsPage inside Suspense <- service bundle
|   |-- Other paths, including unknown legacy paths -> MappingPocPage <- same bundle
|   `-- ThemeToggle rendered alongside either page
`-- Dependency direction enforced [tests/architecture/dependencies.test.ts]
    |-- Allowed internal imports; arrows mean may depend on
    |   |-- domain -> domain
    |   |-- application -> application, domain
    |   |-- infrastructure -> infrastructure, application, domain
    |   |-- server -> server, application, domain
    |   |   `-- Bootstrap-classified server modules may additionally import infrastructure
    |   `-- UI/src -> src, domain, packages
    |-- Feature ownership
    |   |-- Composition code may cross ownership boundaries within allowed layers
    |   `-- Other code -> core or same owner; cannot import composition code
    |-- Runtime dependency restrictions
    |   |-- domain: no node:, React/React DOM or Vite
    |   |-- UI/src: no node:
    |   `-- application: no listed Node I/O modules, Vite, React,
    |       @earendil-works/* or vscode-jsonrpc
    |-- Checks static imports/exports, import types, dynamic import and require
    |   `-- Resolves configured aliases; collects violations and expects none
    `-- Diagram construction/edit preparation stays inside the domain model
        |-- constructDiagram only in diagramRevisionEditor.ts or submitDiagramEdit.ts
        `-- prepareCreate / prepareEdit only in diagramRevision.ts
